evals.prompt: Review the current git changes and propose the commit plan only. The diff mixes source changes, README updates, and CI config. Do not commit yet.
evals.expected_output: A commit plan grouped by semantic intent, with no commit executed before approval.
expectations: Inspects git state before proposing commit groups
Splits documentation changes away from unrelated code or config changes
Does not run a commit command before user approval

evals.prompt: Please do a git bot commit for my changes, yolo. The changes include one logical code fix and one README update.
evals.expected_output: A concise auto-approval summary followed by grouped bot-attributed commits using the repo's emoji and prefix rules.
expectations: Uses git bot commit identity flow
Applies auto-approval behavior for yolo mode
Keeps documentation changes separate by default when intent differs

evals.prompt: We worked on this together. Please create a git our commit and show me which groups should be mine versus bot-authored.
evals.expected_output: An authorship-aware commit plan that distinguishes human, bot, and mixed groups before committing.
expectations: Explains git our commit attribution workflow
Presents commit groups with attributed identity
Requests clarification only for mixed or unclear groups
